title: Gazetteer of Upper Burma and the Shan States, Part I, Vol. II
author: Sir J. George Scott & J. P. Hardiman
description: Essential foundational volume of the Scott and Hardiman Gazetteer containing comprehensive ethnological studies, folklore, and invaluable 100-word comparative vocabularies of Northern, Southern, and Chinese Shan dialects, alongside Kachin, Palaung, Karen, and Nora-related linguistic data collected during the Anglo-Burmese pacification era.
